name: Andrew Rogers
current_role: Administrator of the Wage and Hour Division, U.S. Department of Labor (since October 2025)
summary: Andrew Rogers runs the Labor Department’s Wage and Hour Division, which enforces minimum-wage, overtime and child-labor law. Confirmed 51–47 on October 7, 2025, it is his second stint at the division, where he was a senior adviser in the first Trump administration. He came from the Equal Employment Opportunity Commission, where he was acting general counsel and earlier chief counsel to Acting Chair Andrea Lucas, after about 12 years of wage-and-hour practice.
